videos.title: Is GTA 5 Halal?
videos.title_en: Is GTA 5 Halal? A Saudi Scholar's Rule for Video Games
videos.caption: Is GTA 5 halal? 🎮 A Saudi scholar's rule for video games, applied to what GTA 5 actually contains 🤍 Send this to a gamer friend 👇

sources.ref: Dr. Saad al-Shathri, al-Musabaqat wa Ahkamuha
sources.wording: IslamQA answer 2898 ('Are Video Games Haram?'), credited to Dr. Saad al-Shathri's book al-Musabaqat wa Ahkamuha fi al-Shari'ah al-Islamiyyah; English quotes from https://islamqa.info/en/answers/2898/are-video-games-haram
sources.arabic: والأصل في مثل هذه الألعاب الإباحة إذا لم تصدّ عن واجب شرعيّ كإقامة الصلاة وبرّ الوالدين وإذا لم تشتمل على أمر محرّم

sources.wording: 'If you find these things or some of them in it, then it is not permissible to play it.'

sources.ref: ESRB rating: Grand Theft Auto V
sources.wording: Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, Use of Drugs and Alcohol
member of the Council of Senior Scholars; adviser at the Royal Court

lines.text: Saudi scholar Dr. Saad al-Shathri gave the {rule} for video games.
lines.text2: سعودی عالم ڈاکٹر سعد الشثری نے ویڈیو گیمز کا {اصول} بتایا۔
lines.say: Saudi scholar, Doctor Saad al-Shathri, | gave the rule for video games.
In principle, | such games are permissible,
lines.text0: والأصل في مثل هذه الألعاب الإباحة
lines.text0_ref: Dr. Saad al-Shathri, al-Musabaqat wa Ahkamuha

lines.text: “so long as they do not get in the way of obligatory duties such as establishing {prayer}”
lines.text2: ”بشرطیکہ وہ نماز جیسے {فرائض} سے نہ روکیں“
lines.say: so long as they do not get in the way of obligatory duties, | such as establishing prayer,
lines.text0: إذا لم تصدّ عن واجب شرعيّ كإقامة الصلاة
lines.text0_ref: Dr. Saad al-Shathri, al-Musabaqat wa Ahkamuha

lines.text: “and so long as they do not include anything that is {haram}.”
lines.text2: ”اور ان میں کوئی {حرام} چیز شامل نہ ہو۔“
lines.say: and so long as they do not include | anything that is haram.
lines.text0: وإذا لم تشتمل على أمر محرّم
lines.text0_ref: Dr. Saad al-Shathri, al-Musabaqat wa Ahkamuha

lines.text: Forbidden in games: {nudity}, gambling, music, and getting used to violence and crime.
lines.text2: گیمز میں ممنوع: {عریانی}، جوا، موسیقی، اور تشدد و جرم کی عادت۔
lines.say: Forbidden in games: nudity, gambling, music, | and getting used to violence and crime.

lines.text: GTA 5's official rating lists {nudity}, strong sexual content and intense violence.
lines.text2: GTA 5 کی سرکاری ریٹنگ میں {عریانی}، فحش مواد اور شدید تشدد درج ہے۔
lines.say: GTA 5's official rating lists nudity, | strong sexual content, and intense violence.

lines.text: So by these conditions, GTA 5 does {not} pass.
lines.text2: تو ان شرائط کے مطابق GTA 5 {جائز نہیں} ٹھہرتا۔
lines.say: So by these conditions, | GTA 5 does not pass.

lines.text: IslamQA: “If you find these things or some of them in it, then it is not {permissible} to play it.”
lines.text2: اسلام سوال و جواب: ”اگر اس میں یہ چیزیں یا ان میں سے کچھ ہوں، تو اسے کھیلنا {جائز نہیں}۔“
lines.say: IslamQA says: | If you find these things or some of them in it, then it is not permissible to play it.

lines.text: No game is worth missing {Salah} for. 🤲
lines.text2: کوئی گیم اس قابل نہیں کہ اس کے لیے {نماز} چھوڑی جائے۔
lines.say: No game is worth | missing Salah for.

lines.text: Send this to a gamer friend. 🤍
lines.text2: یہ کسی گیمر دوست کو بھیجیں۔
lines.say: Send this | to a gamer friend.
